methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Kunin operates in Robotics & Manufacturing, a sector represented by a sparse comparable universe of one public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private peers, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The target's stage remains undisclosed, as does its current valuation and total capital raised, limiting precision in peer matching.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains eleven same-sector peers overall, but filtering for matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints in any single cohort—below the minimum threshold for reliable median construction. A broad all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given stage and capital-intensity mismatches across robotics subsegments.

Without sufficient narrow-peer triangulation, conventional quantitative valuation anchors cannot be established from the available data. Credible analysis would require either: disclosure of Kunin's funding stage and capital history to enable tighter peer segmentation, or collection of additional private robotics comparables at matching development phases. The single public comparable and fragmented private set represent material uncertainty in any valuation synthesis. Further data collection is necessary before a defensible range can be articulated.
